title: Sloth wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='74' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='5' y='74' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a8703a'/>
  <!-- arms hanging over branch -->
  <path d='M30 72 q-4 -14 6 -18 q10 -3 10 8 l0 10 z' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <path d='M70 72 q4 -14 -6 -18 q-10 -3 -10 8 l0 10 z' fill='#b07a45'/>

  <ellipse cx='32' cy='56' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#dfc29a'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='54' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#dfc29a'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#dfc29a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='54' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#dfc29a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='20' ry='20' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#d8b184'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#b07a45'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#efdcc0'/>

  <circle cx='43.9' cy='34' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.9' cy='34' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#3a2a20'/>

  <path d='M45 45 q5 3 10 0' stroke='#8a6a4d' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M50 8 L38 26 L62 26 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M50 8 L44 19 L50 17 L56 19 Z' fill='#ffd24d'/>

  <!-- little pom dots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='21' r='1.5' fill='#4de1ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='21' r='1.5' fill='#4de1ff'/>
